verdict.rationale: Browser Use is a browser-automation agent and remote-browser infrastructure. It runs tasks on websites and returns results; it does not store user data in the product. AI-generated insights and suggestions over a user's data held inside the product is an analytics/data-platform axis, so it is a category error here. Data-extraction tasks such as exporting followers to CSV are task outputs, not an in-product insights feature, so they do not make the axis applicable.
